subject.title: fix(polls): add default maximum poll option count

question: Should Matrix polls with more than 20 requested options be silently truncated at the Matrix builder, rejected to preserve every requested choice, or left as passthrough behavior?
rationale: MSC3381's numeric limit does not by itself choose OpenClaw's user-facing loss-versus-failure policy for existing callers, and the proposed silent truncation discards requested poll choices.

options.title: Adopt builder-only truncation
options.body: Keep the current Matrix-only cap so oversized polls remain deliverable, while accepting that choices after the twentieth are omitted.

options.title: Reject oversized polls
options.body: Surface a clear validation error instead of silently dropping choices, preserving caller intent at the cost of failing the send.

options.title: Keep passthrough
options.body: Preserve current OpenClaw behavior until a Matrix policy or upstream interoperability contract is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Adopt builder-only truncation
recommendation.body: Keep the current Matrix-only cap so oversized polls remain deliverable, while accepting that choices after the twentieth are omitted.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the only identified participant currently maintaining the proposed Matrix poll behavior; a Matrix feature-history owner should make the final product choice.
